summary: Crown PropTech Acquisitions, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting an amended and restated Business Combination Agreement with Mkango Rare Earths Limited (MKAR) and affiliates, dated September 2, 2026. The agreement consolidates prior amendments to the original July 2, 2025 deal, clarifies the timing of the Mkango BVI Share Reclassification, and updates sponsor support terms. Crown PropTech is the SPAC target vehicle merging with MKAR to form PubCo. The filing also notes amendment to the Sponsor Support Agreement regarding founder share escrow conditions. No deal price, premium, or close date was disclosed; the transaction remains subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. Watch for redemptions and closing conditions in this SPAC de-SPAC transaction.
